entries.name: Vertical Jump — two linked rises, final stick
entries.sourceName: Vertical Jump — two linked rises, final stick
entries.instruction: Main controlled knee/hip force connection between two upward projections. Each round contains two modest vertical jumps. Use one dip for the first, receive on both feet and make one controlled second rise; then hold the final landing 2 s. Do not rush for short contact time or add a bounce. Recovery: 90 s between complete set rounds; 90 s before the next exercise/section Use instead: two separated countermovement jumps per round with a 15 s reset when first reception cannot support a controlled second takeoff. This replaces remaining work in this slot; follow an explicit replacement dose if stated, otherwise keep the remaining dose/rest. Log changed events or laterality.

entries.name: Medicine Ball Receive-Step Chest Pass — one controlled plant
entries.sourceName: Medicine Ball Receive-Step Chest Pass — one controlled plant
entries.instruction: Primary integration of received load, a single plant and straight-ahead release. Coach softly feeds to a stationary athlete; receive at chest, make one small forward step and release as the foot plants. Stop balanced. One receiving/step/release cycle per rep, then fully reset. Complete one lead foot side, rest 60 s, then the other; 4 total reps. Reset 20 s between reps. Use the stationary catch-set chest pass if receiving or plant control is unconfirmed; if receiving itself is unsuitable use a self-started step pass or stationary pass and log zero catches as appropriate instead of this slot if the stated execution is unsuitable; follow any explicitly stated replacement dose; otherwise retain the remaining dose. entries.name: Kettlebell Deadlift — rapid full-foot rise, no swing
entries.sourceName: Kettlebell Deadlift — rapid full-foot rise, no swing
entries.instruction: Drive a light external load upward through hip/knee extension while retaining whole-foot pressure. Place a light bell between the feet on the floor only if its handle height permits a controlled hinge without rounding. Stand quickly with arms straight and heels down; lower for 3 s to a quiet park and fully reset. No jump, shrug or swing. Recovery: 10 s between individual reps; 90 s before the next exercise/section Use instead: three rapid bodyweight hip-hinge returns with heels down and the same reset/rest if handle height or minimum load is unsuitable.
